label: s1_side02_0060_camera_boxfull
text:
Hey, partner! Looks like you’re full up on
Pokémon, huh? No room in your party or Boxes!\c
Look, I’m trying to keep it a surprise here, but
trust me when I say you’ll want to make some
room in your Boxes, then come talk to me again![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_01
text: I’ve been waiting for you to come by, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_02
text: I managed to develop the photos I took of the\nBloodmoon Beast![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_select_01
text: Show me!

label: s1_side02_0060_select_02
text: How do they look?

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_03
text: Oh, well, fact is that once I got them all printed\nout, I could see that the photos I managed to get\r\nare all blurry or cut off or out of focus...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_04
text: They really aren’t good enough to show anyone—\nnot even you, partner.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_05
text: But still...\c\nOut of all the photos I’ve ever taken, I think they\nmay be my favorites.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_06
text: I think I’d gotten too caught up in my own head.\nWorrying about framing or what judges might say,\r\nalways thinking about what I ought to capture...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_07
text: But just capturing your subjects as they are—\nthat’s what photos should be![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_08
text: You taught me something important, partner.\nSo...thanks for that.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_09
text: Ah! That’s right! Your name! I never even asked\nyou your name, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_10
text: I know that’s awful of me, after all you did to\nhelp, but...mind teaching me your name?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_select_03
text: You can call me [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: s1_side02_0060_select_04
text: ...My name is [VAR 0x0100(0000)].

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_11
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! A perfect name for a
gutsy
kid
like you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_12
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! But what’s with
that
dark
look?
Don’t
want
me
to
know
your
name
or
something?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_13
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well then! Nice to officially meet you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_14
text: The name’s Perrin. A photographer with a\nrenewed love of photography![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_15
text: I can say that with pride now![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_16
text: AH! And your reward![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_17
text: You’ve earned yourself a real choice reward for\nall the help you’ve been![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_18
text: Oh, and this Growlithe of mine has a younger\nbrother that really loves battling...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_19
text: I think you’ll do a better job of raising it good\nand strong.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_system_01
text: You received a Growlithe from Perrin!

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_20
text: Raise it to be reeeaaal strong, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_21
text: I think that about wraps it up. I did what I came\nhere to do, so I guess I should hit the road.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_22
text: I’m afraid this is good-bye.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_23
text: But you know, Growlithe like these are known for\nliving and working together in pairs.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_24
text: Even if they are separated for a while, I bet\ntheir paths might just cross again someday...\r\nso you raise that one with care in the meantime![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_select_05
text: We’ll definitely meet again!

label: s1_side02_0060_select_06
text: I’ll raise this Growlithe to be strong!

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_25
text: Yeah! I’m looking forward to seeing what you\npull off. I’ve got high hopes![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_camera_26
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So bye for now, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Until
next
time![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0060_dog_01
text: Bow-wooow!
